company.name: Nomad Homes
company.shortDescription: Nomad Homes is a real estate agency that offers property buying services.
company.description:
Nomad Homes is a Dubai-based real estate technology platform that helps people buy residential properties through a guided, end-to-end digital and concierge service. Founded in 2019, the company combines technology with expert property advisors to simplify the home-buying process for local and international buyers.
The platform offers a one-stop solution for purchasing property, including personalized property searches, market insights, property viewings, negotiation support, mortgage assistance, and legal paperwork management. Buyers work with a dedicated advisor who helps them identify suitable homes, compare options, and complete transactions smoothly.
